# Four correctness regressions and the gates added after them

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-adoption-assets.mjs. Edit structured sources, not this file. -->

This is a source-backed maintenance record for four reproducible v0.5.1 correctness failures.
It does not identify a reviewer, assign incident severity, or claim an independent security audit.

All four repairs landed in [`a0cb518da23043e549b84f6f4c9cc39726d7c602`](https://github.com/parousia8888/web-app-security-skill/commit/a0cb518da23043e549b84f6f4c9cc39726d7c602)
and are recorded in the [v0.5.2 release evidence](https://github.com/parousia8888/web-app-security-skill/blob/main/docs/releases/v0.5.2.md).

## 1. The main risk summary rendered JavaScript objects

**Minimal reproduction:** A v3 report with risk-domain state totals rendered [object Object] in Markdown and HTML.

**Why it mattered:** The first human-readable summary was damaged even though the structured JSON remained available.

**Repair:** Render byState[state].total and bySeverity explicitly and omit zero-count states.

**Regression gate:** [`test/report-v3-contract.test.mjs`](https://github.com/parousia8888/web-app-security-skill/blob/main/test/report-v3-contract.test.mjs)

**Failure plant:** Restoring the v0.5.1 renderer must make the golden Markdown and HTML assertions fail.

**Remaining boundary:** Golden rendering tests protect the current fixture shapes; they do not prove every future presentation is understandable.

## 2. A pnpm workspace could receive a false confirmed lockfile absence

**Minimal reproduction:** A root pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml covering apps/* still allowed a child package.json to be reported as confirmed missing-lockfile evidence.

**Why it mattered:** The strongest evidence state was assigned without actually resolving the applicable workspace boundary.

**Repair:** Parse bounded pnpm workspace includes and exclusions; malformed or unsupported metadata becomes incomplete evidence and unknown instead of confirmed absence.

**Regression gate:** [`test/source-coverage-ledger.test.mjs`](https://github.com/parousia8888/web-app-security-skill/blob/main/test/source-coverage-ledger.test.mjs)

**Failure plant:** Restoring the adjacent-lockfile-only decision must make the covered pnpm workspace fixture fail.

**Remaining boundary:** The parser supports the documented bounded subset and is not a general YAML evaluator.

## 3. Nested JS/TS templates could make a whole file partial

**Minimal reproduction:** A nested template such as const html = `${`</b>`}</div>` produced unterminated_string_literal and stopped normal source-rule coverage for that file.

**Why it mattered:** The tool failed closed as unknown, but relevant server-rendered code was left unexamined until the user noticed the coverage warning.

**Repair:** Track nested template and expression depth while continuing to inspect executable expressions, including TSX braces.

**Regression gate:** [`test/js-ts-source-audit.test.mjs`](https://github.com/parousia8888/web-app-security-skill/blob/main/test/js-ts-source-audit.test.mjs)

**Failure plant:** Restoring the v0.5.1 tokenizer must make the nested-template coverage fixture fail.

**Remaining boundary:** The tokenizer is still bounded and reports unsupported syntax as incomplete evidence rather than silently passing it.

## 4. A path-only rename could make a retest exit successfully

**Minimal reproduction:** Renaming a file without removing its condition produced one fixed and one new finding, allowing the compatible baseline gate to exit successfully.

**Why it mattered:** The condition still existed, while the baseline presentation implied that the old condition had been fixed.

**Repair:** Pair only one-to-one path-independent equivalents and keep them unchanged with condition_moved; ambiguous duplicates remain unmatched.

**Regression gate:** [`test/report-v3-contract.test.mjs`](https://github.com/parousia8888/web-app-security-skill/blob/main/test/report-v3-contract.test.mjs)

**Failure plant:** Restoring path-bound-only matching must make the rename retest assertion fail.

**Remaining boundary:** condition_moved means an equivalent condition exists elsewhere; it does not prove historical identity or that a git move caused it.

## What these repairs do not establish

- Passing the gates does not establish production vulnerability precision or recall.
- A human-readable report still requires review; presentation tests do not prove comprehension.
- Fail-closed unknown or partial coverage is evidence of a limit, not a passing security result.
- `condition_moved` records an equivalent condition elsewhere; it does not prove file identity or a Git move.
